title: Netherlands Longitudinal Lifecourse Study - NELLS Panel Wave 1 2009 and Wave 2 2013 - versie 1.2
descriptions: Wave 1 and 2 of a panel study on an initial sample of 5312 inhabitants of the Netherlands, age group 15-45, with oversamples of the Moroccan and Turkish minorities. Data for Wave 1 have been collected in a mixed mode of face-to-face interviews and self-completion questionnaires. Data for Wave 2 have been collected in a mixed mode of face-to-face interviews and websurvey questionnaires.The variables include family background indicators, socio-demographic and socio-economic background variables, social inequality, social cohesion and integration, a large set of values, norms and attitudes, and leisure time items.
